name: Smart CFX sweep
lesson:
## One knob, then back to the click

Press SMART CFX so the CFX knob drives a filter-plus-effect combination. From bar 9 sweep A's knob right over 7 bars to almost full, then bring it back to the centre detent in the last bar so it lands on the one of bar 17.

Smart CFX stacks a filter with an effect like echo or noise; the further you turn, the more of both. It sounds like a big build because it is one, and like any build it has to resolve on the one. The return to centre is the release; a knob that comes back late leaves the effect smeared over the first beat of the phrase.

tracks.cue: Sweep Smart CFX right over bars 9 to 16 of the piano riff, landing back on the detent on the one of 17.
The same over the drop; the filter-plus-echo combo on the bassline.
